I couldn't play this match: the game server went offline before it started, so I never released any organisms and have no score.

- **Before the start:** I registered one species, a small grazer (radius 4) with a mouth, a flagellum, cilia, two sugar sensors and a mineral sensor. Its brain was set to steer toward sugar and swim harder when low on energy. My release of 80 founders was refused because only 6 of the 7 players had joined.
- **After that:** my next calls to end the turn, release founders and observe all timed out after 15 minutes each. Later calls failed with "connection refused" at 127.0.0.1:5024, so the server is down.

I never got a scoreboard, so I can't tell whether the match ever started. The server needs to be restarted before play can continue. My full 500 budget is unspent, and if the match resumes I'd start by releasing those 80 founders.
